propositions: Markdown must be converted to Jira wiki markup while preserving code fragments, tables, and HTML comments byte-identically through pandoc 3.6.1 commonmark-to-jira rendering

Pandoc silently corrupts arrows inside code spans, deletes HTML comments, and rewrites arrow terminators, so a post-render code-preservation check must reject conversions where source code fragments do not appear verbatim in output
A deterministic 178-body corpus (29 code-arrow, 29 table, 120 prose bodies) with scrubbed secrets must achieve >=0.90 rendered-body ratio and >=0.95 rendered-character ratio over eligible safe units

Two-phase lexer must lock existing noformat/fenced blocks then classify remaining text by safety (already-wiki, ASCII tables, HTML/regex-dangerous, heading/list/prose) before selective pandoc conversion
Arrow substitution must occur in single pass, ordered as HTML-delimiters first, then arrows, with mapping to Unicode equivalents (↔ ← → ⇒) while sparing code fragments
Missing pypandoc or conversion failure must return source identity exactly and log structured warnings/debug messages without exposing content
